title: Waiting Time When Ball Is Hanging on the Edge of the Hole
question: How long are you allowed to wait to see if your ball that is hanging on the edge of the hole will fall in?

choices.text: Up to 10 seconds from when the ball stopped moving.
A reasonable time to reach the hole, plus an additional 10 seconds.
As long as you like, provided you do not delay play.
You must play the ball immediately without waiting.

explanation: When a ball comes to rest hanging over the hole, you are allowed a reasonable time to reach the hole without unreasonable delay, and then an additional 10 seconds to see whether the ball falls into the hole. If the ball falls into the hole within that time, it is considered holed. If it falls in after that period, add one penalty stroke. (Rule 13.3a)
